settings.title: Phase 1 — Find a niche that actually sells

Using AI to map trending niches and buyer intent

settings.title: Phase 2 — Build the store with AI

Shopify setup, domains and payments
Theme structure, sections and mobile layout
Writing product pages, copy and descriptions with AI
Product photography and image generation
Apps, email capture and abandoned-cart flows
SEO basics so Google can find the store
Speed, trust and legal pages
settings.text: Every class is a screen-share build. You copy the workflow on your own store while we go.

settings.text: Launch is a checklist, not a leap of faith. You will finish with your first campaign ready to run.
settings.outcome: A launch checklist and your first campaign live.

settings.question: Do I need any experience or coding skills?
settings.answer: None at all. We start from zero and every class is a guided screen-share. If you can use Gmail and WhatsApp, you can follow this course.

settings.question: What if I miss a class?
settings.answer: Every session is recorded and posted within 24 hours. You keep lifetime access to all recordings, templates and prompts.

settings.question: How much extra will I need to spend?
settings.answer: You can start with only a domain. Shopify's trial covers the first period, and I show you free ways to source products and create content before you spend on ads.

settings.question: Is this live or recorded?
settings.answer: It is fully live on Google Meet at 9:00 PM IST, with Q&A in every session — plus recordings you can rewatch.

settings.question: Will I really have a store by the end?
settings.answer: Yes. Building is not homework here — we build during class. You finish with a live, mobile-ready store and a launch checklist.

settings.question: What language is the course taught in?
settings.answer: English and Malayalam, with Hindi support in the Q&A. Ask in whichever language you are comfortable with.
